item.title: GitHub Actions leaking secrets when Miri output is cached
item.description: The Rust Security Response Team was notified that Miri stores all environment variables to target/ , allowing secrets to persist in caches. (2 sources: lobsters, rustblog)

item.title: Announcing a Maintainer in Residence: Scott Schafer for the Cargo team
item.description: At the end of August, we announced our first Maintainers in Residence, Rust Project contributors who are funded for their upstream contributions and maintenance work from the Rust Foundation Maintainers Fund (RFMF). (1 source: rustblog)
